answer: Re-attestations are stored in falcon and relic lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the oasis graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 7 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 3579 account sybil into a 5 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
